nodes.label: update.md incremental --update and --cluster-only
nodes.rationale: Detects whether all changed files are code-only and, if so, skips semantic subagent dispatch entirely (AST rebuild only, no LLM cost); uses build_merge() reading graph.json directly (not a NetworkX round-trip) specifically to preserve directed edge semantics for calls/implements/imports (issue #801), and preserves prior-run hyperedges via G.graph['hyperedges'] rather than overwriting them with only the new extraction's hyperedges.
